about:
Century Seals Inc. was incorporated in 1999 in Seaford, Delaware. The company specializes in manufacturing glass-to-metal hermetically sealed components and housings for demanding applications.

Its product line spans kovar packages, TO packages, relay headers, feedthroughs, and custom machined packaging. The firm handles glass-to-metal sealing, precision machining, and plating through its wholly owned subsidiary Fin-Tec, which provides silver and other finishes. While facility size and headcount are not disclosed, the catalog includes standard and custom configurations such as single-pin terminals, sight glasses, sensor packages, and dual-in-line headers.

Century Seals serves aerospace, defense, refrigeration, gas detection, energetic and pyrotechnic, microwave and RF, electromechanical, and microelectronics sectors. The company describes itself as a preferred source in the microcircuit packaging industry, supplying both standard and custom hermetic solutions to original equipment manufacturers and defense contractors.

Management emphasizes honest pricing, clear communication, and respect for business contacts as key differentiators, backed by over 100 years of combined experience among its leadership team. The AS9100D certification underscores its quality commitment for aerospace and defense work.
